companyName: JW Water Holdings and the Robson Utilities acquisition portfolio

result.requestedCompany: JW Water Holdings and the Robson Utilities acquisition portfolio
result.rationale: CVC DIF made two concurrent acquisitions, but the eight Robson utilities were folded beneath JW Water rather than retained as a second PortCo. Pima became a wholly owned JW subsidiary on 2024-11-20, and ACC later said JW owned the full 18-utility group.

identityResolution.boundary: One manager-level platform; Robson Utilities Portfolio is an acquisition cohort and Pima Utility Company is a child utility.

ownershipResolution.structure: DIF VII separately acquired JW Water and the Robson eight; Pima transferred into JW on 2024-11-20. Acquisition SPVs were not disclosed.

operatingResolution.footprint: Arizona; over 50,000 customers. JW's 2026 site lists 18 legacy brands and 20 water/wastewater systems, not a current legal-entity count.
operatingResolution.robsonEight: Lago Del Oro Water Company; Mountain Pass Utility Company; Picacho Water Company; Picacho Sewer Company; Pima Utility Company; Quail Creek Water Company; Ridgeview Utility Company; SaddleBrooke Utility Company.
operatingResolution.jwTen: Bensch Ranch Utilities; Coronado Utilities; Golden Shores Water Company; Navajo Water Company; Payson Water Company; Pine Meadows Utilities; Sunrise Vista Utilities; The Links at Coyote Wash Utilities; Tonto Basin Water Company; Verde Santa Fe Wastewater Company.
operatingResolution.rosterBasis: Robson directly lists its eight; the JW ten are the reconciled remainder of JW's current 18-brand roster.
operatingResolution.legalStatus: ACC approved Bensch/Pine absorption into Verde Santa Fe in 2025 and Quail/Ridgeview/Lago consolidation into JW Water Utility Company on 2026-08-12; the latter's implementation date was not located. Pima's split remains pending.

acquisitionExitCheck.exit: No later sale, transfer or signed manager-level exit found through 2026-08-19; current JW and ACC sources show continued ownership.

pendingTransactions.buyer: Pima Water Company and Pima Sewer Company (proposed)

acquisitionExitCheck.financing: Pima's 2026 applications seek up to $12.5 million of affiliate debt; approval remained pending as of 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Pima became a wholly owned JW subsidiary.
CVC announced the completed JW ten-utility and Robson eight-utility deals through DIF VII.
ACC approved Bensch/Pine/Verde Santa Fe consolidation and said JW owned those three plus 15 others.
ACC approved Quail/Ridgeview/Lago consolidation into JW Water Utility Company.
